ns2:course.label: Drawing II
ns2:course.description: Continuation of ARTF 102 that includes the following drawing concepts: narrative, conceptual, applied, non-objective, format, process, seriality and collage. Open to Art and Design majors only. Prerequisite: ARTF 102.
ns2:course.courseSectionInformation: Open to Art and Design majors only. Prerequisite: ARTF 102.
ns2:course.classScheduleInformation: Class Materials Fee of $35 required. A student registered in one or more Art & Design course(s) exhibiting this message, will be assessed a $95 facility use fee once each term.
